patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column grid for content sections, often pairing a large visual or bold heading with smaller body text.

Extreme typographic scale contrast, featuring monumental sans-serif headings that often span the full width or dominate a section, paired with a clean, readable body text and a distinct monospace for metadata.
Full-bleed, high-contrast color blocking using a core black and white palette, punctuated by vibrant accent colors (orange, purple, muted teal) to define distinct content sections.
Hero section title and abstract background reveal with a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and discovery.
Content sections are dramatically separated by full-bleed background color changes, often featuring a single, dominant typographic element or image.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered reveal for its oversized title and a subtle parallax effect on the abstract background, making elements appear to emerge from the top as the user scrolls down. Subsequent content sections utilize a staggered fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging content flow.

The site uses a flexible, asymmetric grid system that frequently pairs large, impactful visual or typographic elements with supporting text in a two-column arrangement. Full-bleed background colors are strategically used to create strong visual segmentation between distinct content blocks.

A dramatic typographic hierarchy is established through the use of an extremely large, bold display sans-serif for primary headings, a clean and legible sans-serif for body copy, and a distinct monospace font for labels and data, ensuring clear information architecture and visual impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, often uppercase labels and a clean, readable body text.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of oversized typography and full-bleed, high-contrast color blocks to segment content. The massive, full-screen footer that repeats the main title in an even larger scale is a particularly memorable and impactful design choice, transforming a typically utilitarian section into a powerful brand statement.
